name: Custom Perfume Tester Box - Select Any 5 Scents (5ml Each)
description: Craft your unique fragrance journey with our customizable Perfume Tester Box. Choose any 5 perfumes from our exclusive collection of Men’s, Women’s, and Unisex scents, each in a convenient 5ml spray bottle. Whether you're exploring new fragrances or searching for your signature scent, this curated selection offers versatility and luxury in every spray. Discover timeless classics and modern blends tailored to your preferences. Available Fragrances: Men's Perfumes: Ocean Spirit (Fresh & Aquatic) Aventus Spirit (Bold & Dynamic) Night Rider (Mysterious & Elegant) Bold Heat (Strong & Confident) Wild Intense (Rugged & Magnetic) Women's Perfumes: Blossom Shine (Bright & Floral) Infinite Spark (Radiant & Inspiring) Dark Seduction (Rich & Sensual) Floral Charm (Delicate & Feminine) Unisex Perfumes: Silver Breeze (Cool & Refreshing) Smoky Chic (Bold & Sophisticated) Opulent Rouge (Luxurious & Captivating) Why Choose Our Tester Box? Personalized Selection: Pick 5 scents of your choice. Travel-Friendly: 5ml spray bottles ideal for travel and daily use. Premium Quality: Crafted with high perfume oil concentration for long-lasting wear. Exclusive: Available only at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan. Materials & Care: Content: Alcohol-based perfumes with natural oils. Care: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Packaging: Comes in a premium gift box, perfect for gifting or personal use.
